description: Winc is built with Rust and its own rendering engine: it starts in 0.1 seconds and uses just 52 MB of memory with 100,000 lines open. Multiple cursors, find and replace, and side-by-side diffs are all there, and every keystroke and scroll responds instantly.
notes: 官方 Windows 构建只有 x64（portable / setup / msi）；winc-arch-repo-*.zip 是 Arch Linux 仓库包（含 pkg.tar.zst 与 .db），不是 Windows 32bit/arm64 包。
